parrafo.es: McGrath Handyman Services atiende St. Johns y el área de Jacksonville: puertas, estanterías, accesorios, cerraduras y esa lista de pendientes que se sigue posponiendo. Patrick responde rápido, llega cuando dice que llega y deja el trabajo bien hecho.

parrafo_1.es: McGrath Handyman Services es el negocio de Patrick: un hombre, una camioneta y las herramientas para resolver el trabajo. Atiende St. Johns y el área de Jacksonville, desde instalar una puerta hasta montar una repisa o cambiar una cerradura.
parrafo_1.en: McGrath Handyman Services is Patrick's business: one man, a truck, and the tools to get the job done. He serves St. Johns and the greater Jacksonville area, from installing a door to mounting a shelf or changing out a deadbolt.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google cuentan lo mismo una y otra vez: responde rápido, cumple lo que dice y el trabajo queda bien hecho, sin dejar nada a medias.
parrafo_2.en: His clients on Google say the same thing again and again: he responds fast, follows through on what he says, and the job gets done right, nothing left half finished.

texto.es: La lista de pendientes que se sigue posponiendo: puertas, cerraduras, accesorios y los arreglos chicos que nadie más quiere hacer.

texto.en: Fence and gate repair and builds, plus patio and pool screen work.

items.quote: We were very satisfied with McGrath’s service! He was professional and did a great job. He was fast to respond and showed up exactly when he said he would! Highly recommend using Patrick for any of your repair needs!

You know how when you’re moving and selling your home and it feels like everything is piling on? ... Mr. McGrath answered my text request and fit me in the next day. He realized I had purchased the wrong size door, took it and promised to work with myself and my realtor to make it all work ... This was all completed in 2.5 days and a reasonable fee. He responded, communicated and promptly followed through on all agreed to. I highly recommend him for your next project.
Pat did a great job hanging 2 ceiling fans for us...Reasonably priced and did a great time...Absolutely will call him again when we need help with work around the house.
